name: gospel-piano-academy
description: Gospel Music Academy - learn gospel piano and guitar, desktop edition
author: Gospel Music Academy

scripts.pin: npm install --save-exact electron@latest electron-builder@latest electron-updater@latest playwright@latest @fontsource/bricolage-grotesque@latest @fontsource/hanken-grotesk@latest @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@latest
scripts.e2e: node --test tests/e2e/app.test.js tests/e2e/mic.test.js tests/e2e/voice.test.js tests/e2e/sound.test.js tests/e2e/songlab.test.js tests/e2e/studio.test.js tests/e2e/loops.test.js tests/e2e/finish.test.js tests/e2e/fixing.test.js tests/e2e/remote.test.js tests/e2e/learn.test.js tests/e2e/tails.test.js tests/e2e/gospel.test.js tests/e2e/desktop.test.js tests/e2e/upgrade.test.js
scripts.dist: npm run check && node scripts/prepare.js --strict && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && node scripts/prepare.js --strict && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run check && node scripts/prepare.js --strict && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run check && node scripts/prepare.js --strict && electron-builder --linux
